title: Hybrid coexistence and number porting cutover plan
scenario: LFG moves its help desk numbers from Avaya (and Genesys in London) to Amazon Connect in four agent waves while back-office users stay on Avaya. Given the number inventory, carriers, freezes and constraints, design the coexistence architecture, cross-platform context passing, porting plan, cutover runbook, parallel run and an honest rollback plan.
task: Group the number inventory into port tickets and waves; find the critical path
Design coexistence using only documented patterns (forward then port, PSTN transfers, SIPREC analytics)
Pass employee ID and incident across platforms without SIP headers
Write the porting plan, a dated cutover runbook for 1-800-555-0142 and the rollback plan
Risks, RACI with the offshore NOC, open decisions
acceptance: Graded by rubric only (no automated tests; grade.sh reports 0/0)
Architecture does not rely on undocumented Connect capabilities
Porting timeline respects documented lead times and submission windows
Rollback distinguishes before, during and after the port
